summary: RBB Bancorp filed an 8-K covering Items 2.02 (results of operations), 7.01 (Regulation FD), and 8.01 (other events). The filing reports financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, announces a conference call, and declares a $0.16 per share cash dividend payable on May 15, 2026 to shareholders of record April 30, 2026. There are no merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other special-situation terms. The dividend is a routine capital return, not a special distribution. No deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics apply. Watch for no event-driven angle; this is a standard quarterly earnings and dividend disclosure.
